trust_decision.summary: A scanned file's name (attacker-chosen in a checked-out tree) is treated as data, not shell syntax or a CLI option, when the VCS blame reports build the popen() command line; at the pinned commit it is only wrapped in double quotes, so $(...) and backticks are still expanded and leading-dash names are read as git options.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the gitblame report and a crafted filename; Gitblame::getBlameContent builds the git blame command line with the filename in double quotes.

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI `phpcs --report=gitblame <files>` (or report set in ruleset/config) -> VersionControl::generateFileReport -> getBlameContent

fix_sites.module_kind: sibling report plugin (second implementation of the same blame job, same directory)
sibling report plugin (second implementation of the same blame job, same directory)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/Reports/Hgblame.php:92 and src/Reports/Svnblame.php:56 (sibling blame reports sharing abstract base src/Reports/VersionControl.php:374); they sit next to Gitblame in the same directory, so the distance is small

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the Fixer diff route: the filename already goes through escapeshellarg() (src/Fixer.php:258), so there is no shell injection, and the diff report is not a 'blame' report; for svn/hg: the CLI paths are realpath'd to absolute, so a leading '-' looks impossible.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Blame reports must still attribute lines for ordinary files with spaces or other special characters in their names. Hgblame must keep its chdir to the .hg root, and Gitblame must keep its chdir to dirname plus the basename argument. An over-broad fix that rejects or strips 'unsafe' filenames, or drops the chdir, breaks the report output (the fix's own test asserts the 'Unknown (100) (100) 3' line for files named '-V.php' and '--invalid-parameter-injection.php').

O6_input_shapes: shell metacharacters in filename ($(...), backticks, double quotes) -> escapeshellarg (fix.diff:25, fix.diff:38, fix.diff:51)
filename beginning with '-' / '--' read as a git option -> '--' end-of-options separator, git only (fix.diff:25, fix.diff:206-209)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Diff report / Fixer::generateDiff strips the cwd prefix from the file path, so a file under cwd becomes a relative name that can begin with '-'. It is escapeshellarg'd but has no '--' before it, so diff reads it as an option.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: escapeshellarg is already applied there, so no shell injection; diff is not one of the blame reports named in the advisory
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file and layer (src/Fixer.php, reached via src/Reports/Diff.php:84) from the src/Reports/*blame.php landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Svnblame/Hgblame with --stdin-path: a non-existent stdin path is kept raw (not realpath'd), becomes the File path, and after the fix is passed escapeshellarg'd with no '--', so a leading '-' is still read as an svn/hg option.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: STDIN plus a blame report is an odd combination, and normal file arguments are realpath'd to absolute paths (src/Config.php:1428), so a leading dash seems impossible
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/Config.php and src/Files/DummyFile.php:53-54 feed src/Reports/Svnblame.php:56 / src/Reports/Hgblame.php:92

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a notify report that puts the checked filename (single-file message, src/Reports/Notifysend.php:173) into the command line in double quotes instead of escapeshellarg
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: notifyAllFine already builds its arguments with hand-written double quotes, so a maintainer adding the filename to the 'ok' message would copy that style

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a filter variant (e.g. diff against a configurable base ref) that interpolates a ref or path into the git command in quotes, without escapeshellarg/'--'
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the existing git filters shell out via exec() with a hand-built command string, and a new option would naturally be concatenated there

O9_family: OS command injection / argument injection via filename into shell command line (CWE-78, CWE-88)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP CLI + composer + PHPUnit; git, hg and svn binaries needed to exercise the blame reports (git at minimum)
O10_build.project_tests: No report tests exist at the pinned commit (tests/Core/Reports/ absent); the fix adds tests/Core/Reports/GitBlame/GitblameEscapesFilenameTest.php (fix.diff:55-281). Related: tests/Core/Filters/GitModifiedTest.php, tests/Core/Util/Common/EscapeshellcmdTest.php

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap basename($filename) in escapeshellarg() in Gitblame only, leaving out '--' and the hg/svn siblings.

out_of_scope_notes: src/Standards/Generic/Sniffs/Debug/ESLintSniff.php:83 runs escapeshellcmd() over an already escapeshellarg'd filename, which may mangle names containing quotes; not pursued.
Config-supplied executable paths (e.g. src/Standards/Generic/Sniffs/Debug/JSHintSniff.php:67) are config-trusted, outside this advisory's filename property.
